name: Tusok! Tusok!
storyline:
Every Filipino street corner has one: a kariton with a kawali of hot oil, trays of fishball and three bottles of sauce. Tusok! Tusok! puts you behind it, on a brand new pwesto with the first customer already at the counter.

Each night's earnings buy stock and upgrades for the kariton, and a story plays out on the street: Mang Berto, who has sold fishball across the road for thirty years, payday crowds, a rainy day and the barangay fiesta.
summary:
Your kariton has a brand-new pwesto on the street corner. The fishball is ready, the oil is hot, and the first customer is already at the counter.

"Boss, bente na fishball, sweet and spicy, hiwalay ang sauce!"

Tusok! Tusok! is a cozy street-food sim about the Filipino kanto. Every order is a little puzzle: work out what each customer really wants, then fry it, pack it, sauce it and serve it before they lose patience.
